newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-STOCK EXCHANGE WOULD LIKE EESTI GAAS ON MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-STOCK EXCHANGE WOULD LIKE EESTI GAAS ON MARKET.

text.p: The stock exchange on Thursday said it would be pleased if the shares of leading utility Eesti Gaas were quoted on the market after a 12.33 percent stake is sold later this year.
The Estonian Privatisation Agency yesterday decided to sell a 12.33 percent stake in Eesti Gaas via a public offer of 48 million kroons of shares in June.
"Certainly we would be happy to see Eesti Gaas on the official list of the Tallinn stock exchange," said stock market managing director Helo Meigas.
The shares, with a nominal value of 100 kroons, will be sold through a public offering for privisation vouchers in June.
Eesti Gaas is currently listed as a non-public stock with its shares held in the central securities depository.
A privatisation official said that usually when companies were sold for privatisation vouchers, their first step to the market would be via the over-the-counter free market.
